item.title: Inma Inkan ~Shokushu to Gattai Shite Omoidoori ni Yarikaesu~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Silky’s Sakura
  • 発売日: 2024-05-31
  • スコア: 6.24/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 淫魔淫姦～触手と合体して思い通りにやり返す～
  • 英語名: Inma Inkan Shokushu to Gattai Shite Omoidoori ni Yarikaesu

あらすじ

Murakami Yasuharu is a subject of bullying.

Getting ignored, being treated harshly, for so long, he had endured, but they gradually escalated. However, there is no one around him to rely on, and eventually, his spirit is cornered, and exhausted. In the midst of his despair, looking for an easy way to end his life, he comes across a website about demon summoning. As he reads through the article, “If you want to kill yourself, then take revenge,” and with that sentence, he decides to give it a try. Although he is skeptical, he gathers the materials needed for the summoning, at the cost of his own soul, he tries to summon the demon.

item.description:

  • 英語名: Saimin Datsujo 2 Subete ga Boku no Jiyuu ni Naru Sekai e Youkoso Mikado Azusa Hen

あらすじ

Okamura Yuto is a quiet, introverted high school student living an otherwise ordinary life—until he receives a peculiar package from his archaeologist father. Inside is a strange, plate-like artifact etched with mysterious symbols. According to his father, it’s said to be an ancient relic with hypnotic powers—capable of putting people into a trance and accepting any suggestion given.

  • 英語名: Saimin Datsujo Subete ga Boku no Jiyuu ni Naru Sekai e Youkoso Asagiri Kasumi Hen

あらすじ

Okamura Yuuto is an introverted young boy whose father send a relic which can put anybody into an hypnotic state, ready to obey to any suggestion. Disbelieving first, Yuuto discovers that the relic truly has hypnotic power.

Longing for Asagiri Kasumi, his senpai from the same literary club, he crosses the line and uses the relic on her. He starts by extracting personal information, which is how he learns that the rumor about her dating someone is true.

The protagonist is a fat and not-so-good-looking man called Mitsugu Yazaki.

Because of that, he struggles with socializing, and becomes a shut-in. His specialty is beating games. His lover is his 2D girls through his right hand. He is ultimately living his life as a NEET.
